title: Choosing easier tunes late in long parades
summary: Hard marches were played first and easier pieces when tired on the way back.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Well, listen, Tom, when you were playing those long parades like that and you got towards the end, you were getting tired, did you play music a little easier for you to play or did you just keep playing the, I mean, did you have tunes that you thought were a little easier?

Easy? A little easier? Yes. Sometimes you get tired and you pick up a little anything which you think is easy. Yeah. So there's hard marches where we play them when we first start. Yeah, that's right. Yeah, there's hard marches. You see we play them, sometimes you get some tough pieces of march sometimes. But we play them when we first, we refresh. Yeah. Yeah. And when we're coming back, we pick up a little anything.
